description: This file defines data structures, constants, and methods for audit logging in the Mattermost server, including audit record structure, event data, actor info, error info, and utility functions for populating audit records.

classes.name: AuditRecord
classes.description: Represents an audit log entry with fields for event name, status, event data, actor info, meta info, and error info.

classes.name: AuditEventData
classes.description: Contains specific data about the audited event, including parameters, prior and resulting state, and object type.

classes.name: AuditEventActor
classes.description: Represents the subject triggering the audit event, including user ID, session ID, client, IP address, and forwarded IP.

classes.name: EventMeta
classes.description: Stores additional related information for the event, such as API path and cluster ID.

classes.name: AuditEventError
classes.description: Contains error details for failed audit events, including description and status code.

classes.name: Auditable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be audited, returning a map of their data.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Marks the audit record as successful.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Marks the audit record as failed.

methods.name: AddEventParameterToAuditRec
methods.description: Adds a parameter of various types to the audit record's event data.

methods.name: AddEventParameterAuditableToAuditRec
methods.description: Adds an Auditable object as a parameter to the audit record.

methods.name: AddEventParameterAuditableArrayToAuditRec
methods.description: Adds an array of Auditable objects as parameters to the audit record.

methods.name: AddEventPriorState
methods.description: Sets the prior state of the object in the audit record.

methods.name: AddEventResultState
methods.description: Sets the resulting state of the object in the audit record.

methods.name: AddEventObjectType
methods.description: Sets the object type in the audit record.

methods.name: AddMeta
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the audit record's meta information.

methods.name: AddErrorCode
methods.description: Sets the error code in the audit record.

methods.name: AddErrorDesc
methods.description: Sets the error description in the audit record.

methods.name: AddAppError
methods.description: Adds an AppError's details to the audit record.
